correctness.rationale: Franklin cubic graph 12-cycle with alternating +/-5 chords has 18 edges and exactly 17 perfect matchings. The perfect-matching-extendible face complex has 762 faces including empty, f=(1,18,117,264,243,102,17). Independent exhaustive subset enumeration gave reduced F2 Betti [0,0,6,0,0,0]. Source two-stage matched Hasse incidence proof uses 321 elementary collapses plus 56 coreduction pairs, all 377 pair orientations acyclic on 761 nonempty faces, leaving one 0-cell and six 2-cells; that is the FULL integral homotopy wedge of six S2, not inferred merely from modular Betti ranks. Independent reconstruction yielded all 48 graph automorphisms and signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz traces distribution {6:1,2:12,0:20,-2:15}, averaging to zero H2 invariants. Nonplanarity, group action and no equivariant wedge claim respected.
